gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Galaxy draws every letter with one unbroken pen-tip line, spaced loosely so each shape floats on its own. Schibsted Grotesk follows with big, open e and a shapes and terminals that never pinch shut, so a plain sans paragraph stays friendly underfoot.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sen: Galaxy has a dense, tall lowercase band and loose spacing, with a line that never swells or thins. Sen takes over below with tall letters and curves that stop before turning inward, so a full paragraph feels modern and unhurried.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky, with a tall midzone and curves that never clog, while Galaxy above it sprawls cosmic and loose. Sintony keeps a plain sans paragraph moving without snagging, and the y in Galaxy gets a tail as thick as its arm.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands its lowercase tall, like cut acrylic stencil pieces, with rounded letters and no thick-and-thin shifts at all. Sofia Sans carries a long paragraph in that same sans voice, leaving Galaxy to be the loose, cosmic showpiece above.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Clean lines run through Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, whose lowercase nearly reaches capital height, under the loose, commanding spacing of Galaxy. Paragraphs stay crisp and compact.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sono: Sono reads wide and approachable, with tall lowercase and each a left slightly ajar, set under Galaxy's loose, steady line. Sono gives the pair its strongest quality: a heading of cosmic drama sitting over text that breathes.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline brings a monoline skeleton, a deep middle band and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp beneath Galaxy's cosmic swagger. Its strength is plain, crisp clarity.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads big-bodied and open, with curves you can see right into and rod-stock horizontals and verticals, under Galaxy. Size it up a touch for comfort.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-stack-sans-text: Marker-like and big-bodied, Stack Sans Text keeps its curve endings well apart beneath the loose, uninterrupted line of Galaxy. Stack Sans Text is the pair's strongest quality: a commanding heading over a body that stays open and easy going.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sulphur-point: Bulky and bold in the lowercase, Sulphur Point keeps distinct gaps in c, e, s and a, under the cosmic, loosely spaced Galaxy. Galaxy sets the drama; Sulphur Point does the steady talking.
